name: Nono Hana
source:
A mysterious peddler who sells fresh (and rare) ingredients directly from the production area.

Her true identity is that of a descendant of the ninja, a group that has survived to this day in small numbers. However, there seems to be an ironclad rule that to let this fact be known is synonymous with death, She tries desperately to hide it. However, it is obvious that she has a shuriken in her hand.

She looks young because of her superhuman physical training. And, by the way, she is married. She also knows various erotic ninja techniques as part of her espionage skills, and is a sex professional.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=540985&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
